title: MOUSE
creator: Myriagone
summary: An old riverboat vanished without a trace, yet its whistle can still be heard on foggy nights.
You and your crew venture aboard to investigate the mystery.
An eerie, black-and-white atmosphere gives the trip the feel of a lost cartoon.
Explore carefully and see whether you can make it back to shore.

title: BLEACHED HOUSE
creator: Bleached House
summary: A late-night craving sends you into the city in search of something to eat.
Ordinary streets and familiar places slowly begin to feel unsettling.
The experience mixes story-driven exploration with tense horror moments.
Bring friends and find out how the night unfolds without knowing what comes next.

title: Retrograde
creator: Pale Hour
summary: Retrograde is an episodic psychological horror experience inspired by real events.
The narrative uses conversations and text messages to build unease.
You are encouraged to pay attention to the dialogue and your surroundings.
It supports a small group, although its quieter moments can be especially intense alone.

title: Phobics
creator: Chill's Creations
summary: Phobics invites you to confront different fears through a collection of portals.
Each experience introduces a new setting and its own sense of danger.
Some areas feature mazes and unsettling, liminal environments.
Explore with friends and see which fears you can face together.

title: he ate them.
creator: he ate them. [COMMUNITY]
summary: Something is wrong with Steak, and the people around him are starting to notice.
This short horror experience builds on a creator-inspired internet story.
Expect an unsettling atmosphere and moments of sudden danger.
Go in without spoilers and discover what has everyone so concerned.

title: THRESHOLD
creator: Reskioat
summary: THRESHOLD pairs a story-based horror adventure with a high-pressure chase mode.
Some encounters react to sounds picked up by your microphone.
Dark environments and unpredictable pursuit make communication part of the tension.
Bring friends, keep your composure, and think before you speak.

title: Short Horror Games
creator: Cryptid Horror
summary: This experience bundles several standalone horror stories into one place.
Each story offers its own setting, mood, and scary situations.
Sessions are designed to be approachable without committing to a huge campaign.
Pick a story, invite up to three friends, and see which one unsettles you most.

title: House of The Locust
creator: NULLWORKS STUDIOS
summary: You find yourself inside a disturbing nest belonging to an ominous creature.
The place feels hostile, and escaping is the central challenge.
Expect a fast-paced horror experience shaped by suspense and sudden scares.
Move carefully with your group and search for a way out.

title: The Curse
creator: ItzMePanos
summary: You follow an investigator trying to make sense of a series of disturbing experiences.
Unfamiliar sights and sounds make even quiet moments feel unsafe.
The game leans into psychological horror, exploration, and story.
Pay attention to the atmosphere and uncover the mystery for yourself.

title: SEWER SCREAMS
creator: Kumis Studios
summary: Enter a network of eerie sewers and search for what has been lost.
A dangerous presence turns each run into a race against your nerves.
As you progress, you choose whether to head upward or venture deeper.
Stay alert and work with your team to survive the darkness.

title: A Quiet Place: Deadzone
creator: Bitter Oats Productions
summary: Deadly extraterrestrial creatures have turned your hometown into a dangerous silence zone.
These creatures are extraordinarily sensitive to sound.
Survival depends on careful movement and the decisions you make under pressure.
Explore with others, stay quiet, and try to make it through.

title: Backrooms Company
creator: Devs 4 U Productions
summary: Descend into eerie lower levels with a team and a job to do.
Collect samples and evidence while navigating uncertain environments.
Different runs challenge you to balance curiosity against getting home safely.
Return to headquarters with whatever you can recover.

title: After 3 AM
creator: The Grand Development
summary: You are staying in a remote rental shack after a disturbing experience at your previous job.
Reports of nearby attacks make an ordinary night feel increasingly dangerous.
Your objective is straightforward: get out of the area alive.
This story-driven horror sequel is especially fun to brave with friends.

title: The Mimic
creator: CTStudio
summary: The Mimic brings several Japanese-inspired horror tales to life.
Each chapter places you in a different eerie setting.
Exploration and unsettling encounters keep the tension high.
You can face its mysteries alongside friends.

title: CONSENSUS
creator: Unverified creator
summary: CONSENSUS is presented as an upcoming cooperative Roblox horror experience.
Its promotional artwork hints at uncanny characters and an unsettling atmosphere.
The exact gameplay mechanics have not been independently confirmed.
The Roblox experience listing is not yet verified.

title: DOORS
creator: LSPLASH
summary: DOORS is a co-op horror adventure built around opening rooms and surviving what lies ahead.
Every run rewards careful observation.
Unusual sounds and unexpected encounters make the next doorway feel risky.
Learn from each attempt without spoiling the surprises.

title: The Rake REMASTERED
creator: RVVZ
summary: A hostile creature stalks the forest after nightfall.
You must find ways to hide, gather supplies, and stay alive.
The darkness makes even familiar paths dangerous.
Try surviving another night with friends.

title: West Wood
creator: West Wood Group
summary: West Wood strands you in a remote Canadian community.
When night falls, something dangerous begins to roam.
Finding resources and choosing when to move are part of survival.
Stay close to your group as you try to outlast the night.

title: Demonology
creator: Blaqk Magic Blue
summary: Demonology turns paranormal investigation into a team challenge.
Use different tools to search haunted locations.
Watch for strange signs and compare what you discover.
Work together to identify the presence without rushing your conclusions.

title: SUITBORN
creator: TC9 Studios
summary: You have been assigned a night shift inside an old facility.
The environment is filled with unsettling signs of danger.
Careful movement and awareness can make all the difference.
Try to finish your shift without encountering what lurks inside.

title: FNAF: Eternal Nights
creator: Cob-Studios
summary: FNAF: Eternal Nights recreates the unsettling world of Five Nights at Freddy’s on Roblox.
Familiar animatronic threats make every sound worth noticing.
Teamwork and quick decisions help build the suspense.
Expect intense scares without needing to know the story beforehand.

title: Dead Silence
creator: DoomX10
summary: Dead Silence invites a small group to investigate a chilling urban legend.
The investigation leads through locations full of unsettling details.
Atmosphere and sound make quiet moments feel especially tense.
Bring friends if you would rather face the mystery together.

title: Silent Mansion
creator: Coffee Cap
summary: Silent Mansion sends you into a building surrounded by a terrible curse.
Its rooms conceal dark mysteries and unnerving encounters.
Exploring carefully is as important as surviving sudden scares.
Find out what this place is hiding with your group.

title: LOST ROOMS [VILLAGE]
creator: MorbidStudios
summary: LOST ROOMS puts players in unfamiliar places filled with unpredictable danger.
Exploration and survival are the focus.
Dark environments encourage careful listening and communication.
Stick with your friends as you make your way through the unknown.

title: Floors Have Teeth
creator: Apparition Pictures V2
summary: A request for help takes you into a disturbing horror adventure.
The game uses a retro visual style to make ordinary places feel strange.
Expect tense exploration and encounters with dangerous figures.
Discover where the story takes you without learning the outcome in advance.

title: Aisles Of The Locust
creator: Tether Community
summary: A routine grocery trip becomes a disturbing cooperative horror experience.
The store contains more than the items on your list.
Staying alert and moving carefully can help you avoid danger.
Bring friends and see whether you can make it out.
